newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO (Hong Kong) Group to launch US$200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: COSCO (Hong Kong) Group to launch US$200 mln loan.

text.p: COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd has mandated HSBC Investment Bank Asia to arrange a US$200 million revolving credit/term loan facility, bankers said.
They said the arranger is now seeking underwriters to join the deal.
The facility has a maturity of five years and pays a margin of 75 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for underwriters is about 84 basis points.
COSCO (Hong Kong) Group is a wholly owned unit of China's Ocean Shipping (Group) Co, which is controlled by the Ministry of Communications of China.
COSCO (Hong Kong) Group also holds a major share of Hong Kong-listed COSCO Pacific Ltd.
